significance: A temple at Ramakrishnapuram, Kothapet in Hyderabad enshrining Lakshmi in her eight aspects, from Adilakshmi to Varalakshmi. Raised under the auspices of the Kanchi Kamakoti Peetam after five years of work, it was consecrated in April 1996 and follows the plan of the Ashtalakshmi temple in Chennai.
